**Recommendation Letter for Umar Bello**  

**Working Relationship**  
Umar has collaborated with our team intermittently over the past 18 months, primarily on cross-functional data pipeline projects. His role at NexaCorp aligns with our needs, and we’ve maintained a professional yet approachable dynamic. He consistently communicates proactively, ensuring alignment on priorities without micromanagement.  

**Day-to-Day Observations**  
Umar’s daily work revolves around maintaining and scaling enterprise data pipelines. He recently reduced query latency by 40% in our customer analytics system by optimizing Spark job configurations. His attention to detail ensures systems run with minimal downtime, and he frequently shares insights to refine our team’s approach to cloud cost efficiency. While he doesn’t publicly promote his tools, his use of Kafka and Airflow has quietly improved data freshness across multiple projects.  

**Standout Moments**  
During a critical outage last quarter, Umar diagnosed a Kafka cluster bottleneck within hours and implemented a dynamic scaling solution, restoring full capacity in under 24 hours. His ability to balance technical depth with clear communication also shone when he mentored a junior engineer, resulting in a 30% improvement in their team’s ETL process efficiency.  

**Recommendation**  
Umar is a reliable, results-driven engineer with a knack for solving complex problems under pressure. His work ethic and collaborative mindset make him a strong fit for roles requiring both technical expertise and cross-team coordination. I recommend him without reservation for positions that demand precision, scalability, and a proactive approach to system reliability.
